text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm about to merge a docs PR that consolidates the 429 troubleshooting playbook and adds localized strings for fallback guidance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6789

dan: Which snippets are changing? I want to triage SDK impacts.

maria: Short list: JS SDK retry header example, Python backoff wrapper, and the context-trim example that shows fallback to a shorter model. Also updated the error matrix table.

priya: For i18n: the new user-facing text has two placeholders — {window} and {retryAfter}. Please make sure translators get context notes.

leo: Can we avoid embedding long code blocks in the localized strings? We should keep them in the snippet files and reference them.

alex: I'll update the snippet repo. Plan: 1) change JS snippet to use the unified retry header; 2) add a short note about 429 vs 504 behavior; 3) run unit tests on snippets. ETA EOD.

maria: Thanks — also added a short troubleshooting checklist for ops in the runbook section. It references the fallback routing policy and suggests checking KV-cache shard metrics.

dan: I noticed two dead links in the error matrix (old RFC IDs). I'll push a tiny link-fix PR and point it at the new routing docs.

priya: For localization workflow: please add the new strings to the pot file and tag me in the PR. Also add translator notes for severity and fallback examples.

alex: Quick snippet diff (inline in PR):
```js
// before: naive retry
await client.generate({ prompt });
// after: use retry header for coordination
await client.generate({ prompt, headers: { 'x-retry-policy': 'idempotent' } });
```

leo: Nice. Can you also add one small integration smoke test that hits the staging docs build and looks for the localized key? We had regressions before.

docs-bot: Checklist: link-check ✅, build preview pending, i18n POT updated? pending, snippet tests running.

maria: Release window? We want this in the next docs push (Thu). If snippets/tests aren't green by Wed afternoon, we'll hold.

alex: I'll ping here once CI is green or if I need help.

dan: I'll open the tiny link-fix PR now and cc @priya for localization context.

priya: Thanks — will review the POT changes. Also flagging that some languages need shorter phrasing for the fallback note; may require slight copy edits.

maria: Cool. Appreciate the quick turnaround — this should reduce confused support tickets for 429/context-limit behaviour. :thumbsup:

alex: CI green — snippet tests passed. Pushed updated snippets to PR 6789.

maria: Merged. Marking follow-ups: add one smoke test, close link-fix, follow up on translations.

leo: Filing a small follow-up issue for the smoke test.

docs-bot: Action items updated: follow-up issue #7890 created.

maria: Great job everyone, closing thread. :rocket:
